scenarios.title: A weather-science question gets a brief labelled answer, no strike
scenarios.say: What is DNI and why does it matter for building energy models?

args.text: DNI (direct normal irradiance) is the solar beam measured on a surface facing the sun. Simulation tools split sunlight into direct and diffuse parts, so DNI drives window gains, shading and photovoltaic yield.
